explication: Libraries.dev is a suite of seven React visual-effect libraries, with showcase sites and a central Studio for live configuration. The primary workflow is to choose an effect, configure it through props or Studio, then use the component in an application. The README documents native ports for some libraries and the Studio agent; sampled source is incomplete, so those links are shown only where the tree or excerpts support them.
